## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

Record checks actually run, results and any gaps. Include phone acceptance when relevant.

## Preview

Link and deployed source commit, or explain why a preview is not needed/not available.

## Release state

State the review base, version/gate status and whether production release is authorized.
Merging to main triggers production deployment. Preview approval alone is not a release request.

## Remaining work

List material limits or deferred follow-up. Exclude secrets, personal records and raw logs.
